description: The Globe of Science and Innovation is the timber sphere at Meyrin, about 27 metres high and 40 metres across, built as the Palais de l'Equilibre for the 2002 national exhibition and reopened on this site in 2004. The frame is the wooden exterior and the plaza, not an interior, and no name is readable on the shell. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and cool, about 15°C, with a light wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
